Q01: Unit counts and strengths match the verified OOB table.
Q02: Provenance completeness: no datum without source and tier; no documented tier without a source extract.
Q03: No anachronisms. Every item in every manifest is valid on its date and for its unit (dress, arms, badges, flags, equipment, vehicles, structures); every 1863 structure exists on its date; no modern object (monuments, avenues, fences, signs, wires, markers) appears.
Q04: Arrival check. No entity of a unit exists in the scene before its arrival window opens; scan every frame range of every scenario.
Q05: Position-time plausibility: speeds on foot, horse, limber, wagon and in column within documented ranges; no teleport; continuous trajectories.
Q06: March-to-position check. Every unit has a continuous documented or inferred path from its previous position to its fighting position; no unit appears already deployed.
Q07: Fence and wall state-change times. Each damaged, dismantled, burned or flattened fence, wall or gate changes state at its documented time window (or is flagged with an open register entry); intact before, damaged after, and the transition is visible.
Q08: No pre-placed earthworks. Every earthwork, breastwork and gun emplacement is absent before its construction start, passes through documented construction states (staking, digging, piling, completion), and carries a work crew in the construction interval; completion times match sources or are flagged.
Q09: Building states (intact, damaged, burning, burned, loopholed, hospital use) change at documented times; the Bliss buildings burn July 3 morning; the McPherson barn does not burn July 1.
Q10: Night visibility check. At every night time, render test frames and assert minimum luminance and contrast for every unit and activity in view; the sky is dimmed; moon and stars follow the ephemeris.
Q11: Ephemeris check: sun and moon values equal an independent ephemeris at the site and times.
Q12: Scrub test. Random-access seeks (forward and backward, including jumps across the whole window) produce state identical to sequential playback at the same time; no unit pops; the cache header seed and code version match.
Q13: Audio delay equals distance divided by the speed of sound at the modeled temperature; attenuation and occlusion tests; silence in empty woods except documented ambient.
Q14: Ordnance ranges, elevations and rates of fire within documented figures; per-battery gun counts match the verified battery table.
Q15: Frame-time budget at target agent counts in the headless benchmark.
Q16: Photo-match tests at known camera positions of period photographs (staged-photograph flags respected).
Q17: Coverage: every timeline row has a visual realization or an open register entry.
Q18: Requirement coverage: all 21 requirement IDs have sub-requirements, each passing or linked to an open register entry with an active reconstruction.
Q19: Claim ledger: every visible-result datum has two independent sources or a flag; no lead-only support.
Q20: Cavalry presence: every documented cavalry unit appears at its documented times with its manifest, horses and arms.
Q21: Vegetation state check: crop, canopy and ground-cover state per field per date within the documented-or-ranged schedule.
Q22: Weather state check: scene weather matches the weather timeline at every time.
Q23: Marking check: every non-documented item carries a render flag; no unmarked procedural content.
Q25: Library audit coverage: every source in the acquisition list is ingested , blocked with register entry , or scheduled with a reason.
Q26: Casualty and hospital flow: every casualty event has a carry path to an aid station, field hospital or burial; field hospitals show the documented activity in the documented interval.
Q28: Epilogue gate (R22): the Nov 19 chapter has every B.12.2 row and every S-080 to S-088 state with a tier; Lincoln’s clothing, voice and wording are used only where two sources were read in the audit and otherwise marked reconstruction in the viewer; the version of the address shown is a selectable alternative in the conflict register; no off-Gettysburg event appears in the film path; the jump is labeled as a device.
Q27: Budget gate: spend and compute against the Appendix F caps reported; cap breach triggers the stop condition (Section C and D.5.12). Run a fresh-context verification subagent for each milestone with instructions to flag only correctness and requirement gaps. Do not self-certify what you have not run.
